<?php
// E2E probe (test only). Short-circuits gateway HTTP (counting calls) and exposes helpers for the hardening test.
add_filter( 'pre_http_request', function ( $pre, $args, $url ) {
	if ( false === strpos( (string) $url, 'transactiongateway' ) ) { return $pre; }
	update_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_http_count', (int) get_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_http_count', 0 ) + 1 );
	return array( 'headers' => array(), 'body' => 'response=1&responsetext=SUCCESS&transactionid=CAP1&authcode=A1', 'response' => array( 'code' => 200, 'message' => 'OK' ), 'cookies' => array(), 'filename' => null );
}, 10, 3 );
add_action( 'wp_loaded', function () {
	if ( empty( $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ) ) { return; }
	$mode = sanitize_key( $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] );
	header( 'Content-Type: application/json' );
	$gid = 'cardz3n_gateway';
	$make = function ( $method, $status, $captured ) use ( $gid ) {
		$o = wc_create_order();
		$o->set_payment_method( $method );
		$o->set_total( '10.00' );
		$o->update_meta_data( '_cardz3n_transaction_id', 'T-' . wp_rand( 1000, 9999 ) );
		$o->update_meta_data( '_cardz3n_authorized_amount', '10.00' );
		if ( $captured ) { $o->update_meta_data( '_cardz3n_captured_amount', '10.00' ); }
		$o->set_status( $status );
		$o->save();
		return $o->get_id();
	};
	if ( 'count' === $mode ) {
		echo wp_json_encode( array( 'count' => (int) get_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_http_count', 0 ) ) );
		exit;
	}
	if ( 'orders' === $mode ) {
		if ( ! current_user_can( 'manage_woocommerce' ) ) { echo wp_json_encode( array( 'error' => 'login' ) ); exit; }
		echo wp_json_encode( array(
			'nonce'     => wp_create_nonce( 'cardz3n_gw_nonce' ),
			'other'     => $make( 'bacs', 'on-hold', false ),
			'captured'  => $make( $gid, 'processing', true ),
			'cancelled' => $make( $gid, 'cancelled', false ),
			'ok'        => $make( $gid, 'on-hold', false ),
		) );
		exit;
	}
	if ( 'hidden' === $mode ) {
		$gw = WC()->payment_gateways()->payment_gateways()[ $gid ];
		$gw->settings['enabled'] = 'no';
		$gw->enabled             = 'no';
		$count = function () {
			$n = 0;
			foreach ( (array) glob( trailingslashit( WC_LOG_DIR ) . 'cardz3n-gateway*.log' ) as $f ) { $n += substr_count( (string) file_get_contents( $f ), 'Gateway hidden. Reason: disabled' ); }
			return $n;
		};
		delete_transient( 'cardz3n_gw_last_avail_' . $gid );
		$before = $count();
		for ( $i = 0; $i < 4; $i++ ) { $gw->is_available(); }
		echo wp_json_encode( array( 'new_log_lines' => $count() - $before ) );
		exit;
	}
	if ( 'pay' === $mode ) {
		$src = isset( $_GET['src'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_GET['src'] ) ) : 'card';
		if ( function_exists( 'wc_load_cart' ) && null === WC()->session ) { wc_load_cart(); }
		$o = wc_create_order();
		$o->set_payment_method( $gid );
		$o->set_total( '5.00' );
		$o->set_billing_email( 'e2e@example.test' );
		$o->save();
		$_POST = array( 'cardz3n_payment_token' => 'tok-e2e', 'cardz3n_token_type' => $src, 'cardz3n_payment_source' => $src );
		$before = (int) get_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_http_count', 0 );
		$gw = WC()->payment_gateways()->payment_gateways()[ $gid ];
		$r  = $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
		echo wp_json_encode( array( 'result' => is_array( $r ) ? $r['result'] : 'none', 'http_calls' => (int) get_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_http_count', 0 ) - $before ) );
		exit;
	}
	exit;
}, 20 );
